text:
sre-bot: ALERT: log_alert: high 'writer.errors' rate on prod/west-1 - firing (threshold=50/min)

olivia: seeing pagers for writer-errors, spike started ~16:10, ~30% of requests returning 500 from writer-01 pool :grimacing:

ajay: I can take a look, formatting logs now. Is this a new stacktrace or known flaky client?

olivia: unknown, quick grep shows a recurring traceback fragment 'io.netty.channel..TimeoutException' but also a bunch of internal rate-limit signatures. looks noisy.

lucas: copying logs snippet:```
2026-03-10T16:11:02Z writer-01 ERROR request_id=abc123 msg="write failed" err="io.netty.channel.TimeoutException
 at ...
 at com.redwood.WriterClient.write(WriterClient.java:67)"
```

ajay: thanks. two angles: 1) live mitigation so customers aren't paged for non-actionable noise 2) follow-up: tighten rule with regex/signature for that known timeout pattern and add debounce.

olivia: going to mute the alert channel and escalate only if p99 latency > 1s or 5xx rate > 10% — want to avoid noise while we triage. @oncall-bot please ack and set incident status to "investigating (noise-mitigated)"

oncall-bot: @olivia acknowledged. Alert group muted for 30m for rule 'log_alert: writer.errors'. Incident: INC-20260310-4123 created.

ajay: quick query I'm using to enumerate noise sources (Elasticsearch):```
GET /_search
{
  "query": { 
    "bool": {
      "must": [ { "match": { "service": "writer" } }, { "match": { "level": "ERROR" } } ],
      "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "now-1h" } }
    }
  }
}
```

ajay: found ~1200 hits last hour, ~700 matching the TimeoutException fragment. rest are varied (rate-limit, db pool full).

lucas: For alert tuning proposal:
- add a regex exclude to the log alert for the netty TimeoutException (we consider it transient)
- add signature 'db_pool_exhausted' for errors containing 'connection pool is exhausted' and keep that one as page-worthy
- change threshold to 200/min and make a 5m debounce to reduce flapping
- create a dashboard panel showing writer-errors by signature and host for 24h

olivia: agree with signatures. We should also push a short-term rate-limit rollback for traffic spikes if the spike correlates with a release. Any recent deploys?

ajay: no deploys to writer in last 48h per deploy-bot. Looks like client side retries increased.

kate: I'm stepping in for the oncall handoff at 16:30. I'll take ownership of mitigation and follow-up.

kate: updating the alert rule now in staging: adding exclusion regex and a new signature. Proposed exclusion regex (ECMAScript):```
/TimeoutException(\.|:)?/i
```
This will filter messages that include TimeoutException in the stack.

ajay: prefer a slightly stricter regex to avoid accidental matches:```
/ TimeoutException .*WriterClient/i
```
Matches the writer client timeout specifically.

kate: applied change in staging and re-run the rule against last 2 hours, result: alerts dropped from 1200 to 520 (still actionable).

olivia: good. Can you also add a signature for 'db_conn_pool_timeout' to catch the pool exhausted errors? Sample pattern:```
/connection pool (is )?exhaust(ed|ion)/i
```

kate: added signature 'db_conn_pool_exhaustion' and marked it as critical (no exclude). Live test: rule now fires only for the pool errors and the remaining writer timeouts that include WriterClient.

lucas: next steps for post-incident change:
1) commit rule changes to terraform/grafana-as-code with comments: why we excluded netty timeout fragments and why pool exhaustion remains paged
2) add alert debounce 5m and bump threshold from 50->200/min with evaluation window 5m
3) add dashboard panel (Grafana) 'Writer errors by signature' (timeseries + top hosts)
4) schedule a 1hr blameless postmortem to validate signatures against historical data

kate: committing terraform diff now. snippet:```
resource "alert_rule" "writer_errors" {
  name = "writer_errors_log_alert"
  query = file("alerts/writer_errors_query.json")
  exclude_regex = ["/\\bTimeoutException\\b.*WriterClient/i"]
  signatures = ["db_conn_pool_exhaustion"]
  threshold = 200
  debounce = "5m"
  notify = ["#oncall-critical"]
}
```

ajay: please include test vectors for the excluded pattern in the PR — saves redeploy cycles.

kate: will do. I've added two test loglines under alerts/tests/writer_timeout_sample.log and added CI check.

olivia: customer impact check: ops-telemetry shows 5 customers had degraded writes during the spike, but retries handled most cases. No SLO burn > 10% for any single customer. We should reach out to the 5 customers with a heads-up note.

lucas: adding a short customer outreach draft: "We observed transient write errors in region west-1. We have applied monitoring refinements and are continuing to investigate. Please reach out if you see repeated failures."

kate: PR opened: "tune(writer_errors): add exclude regex, signature for pool exhaustion, debounce" -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/9876

olivia: thanks — I'll handle the customer messages and schedule the PM to join the postmortem. Reopen paging if anything changes. :thumbsup: 

sre-bot: Incident INC-20260310-4123 updated: mitigations applied, alert group muted, follow-up PR created https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/9876. Status: monitoring.

kate: handing off to next oncall @ajay for overnight monitoring, I'll follow up in the postmortem tomorrow morning.

ajay: ack, monitoring for 6h and will escalate if pool_exhaustion > 5/min for >10m.

olivia: thread summary for postmortem: 1) root cause: transient netty timeouts + client retry amplification 2) immediate mitigation: mute noisy timeout signatures, add explicit signature for pool exhaustion 3) config changes: exclude regex, signature, debounce 5m, threshold bump to 200/min 4) follow-up: dashboard + postmortem + customer outreach

lucas: adding to the incident doc and scheduling the 1hr follow-up at 10:00am PDT tomorrow.

sre-bot: Closing note: please attach tests to the PR and include before/after alert counts for audit.

olivia: thanks everyone, nice fast teamwork.
